extensions.name: AI Commenter
extensions.description: Select a function and let AI write a documentation comment above it. Example of the “ai” permission — uses whichever AI provider you set up.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Encode / Decode
extensions.description: Base64 and URL encoding and decoding of the selected text (full Unicode support).
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Case Converter
extensions.description: Converts the selected text to camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, PascalCase, UPPER or Title Case. Example of quick picks and editing the selection.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Color Tools
extensions.description: Select a color like #ff8800, rgb(255,136,0) or hsl(32,100%,50%) and convert it to another format.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: HTML Starter Snippets
extensions.description: Type a shortcut like “html5” or “card” in an HTML file and press Enter to get a ready-made block. Example of a snippets extension.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: JSON Tools
extensions.description: Format, minify and sort the keys of JSON — the whole file or just the selection. Tells you exactly where invalid JSON breaks.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Line Tools
extensions.description: Sort, reverse, shuffle, remove duplicates or empty lines, number or trim the lines of your selection (or the whole file).
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Lorem Ipsum
extensions.description: Inserts placeholder text — as many words, sentences or paragraphs as you ask for. Handy for web page mockups.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Nature Themes
extensions.description: Three calm palettes: Dune (warm sand), Glacier (icy blue) and Plum (deep violet). Each works in light and dark mode.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Python Starter Snippets
extensions.description: Shortcuts for common Python code: main block, functions, classes, loops, file reading and input. Type the shortcut and press Enter.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: React Snippets
extensions.description: Quick React building blocks: function components, useState, useEffect and list rendering for JavaScript and TypeScript.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Sakura Theme
extensions.description: Soft cherry-blossom pinks for light and dark mode. Example of a theme extension — no code needed, just a few numbers.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Timestamp
extensions.description: Inserts the current date and time in the format you pick: ISO 8601, Unix seconds, local date, and more.
extensions.author: Stride

extensions.name: Word Count
extensions.description: Shows words, characters and reading time of the open file in the status bar. A small example of status bar items and editor events.
extensions.author: Stride
